name: Dr. Sarah Chen
title: Senior AI & Machine Learning Engineer
bio: Specialized in LLM agents, LangGraph workflows, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, and low-latency computer vision systems. 7+ years of experience delivering scalable AI systems.

case_studies.title: Enterprise Knowledge Agent with LangGraph & Hybrid RAG
case_studies.deliverables: Autonomous multi-agent research copilot over 100k financial documents, achieving 94% evidence grounding and sub-second retrieval.
case_studies.metrics: Reduced analyst query time by 78%, processed 2.4M queries/month at $0.003/query.
case_studies.full_text: Built a production-grade multi-agent document analysis system utilizing LangGraph for parallel retrieval, BM25 + dense vector hybrid search, and cross-encoder reranking. Deployed using FastAPI and Redis cache.

case_studies.title: Local LLM Fine-Tuning & High-Throughput Serving with vLLM
case_studies.deliverables: HIPAA-compliant on-premise clinical notes extraction system using quantized open-weight Llama-3-70B.
case_studies.metrics: Achieved 42 tok/sec throughput on 2x A10G GPUs with 99.2% extraction precision.
case_studies.full_text: Configured private inference engine with vLLM paged attention and continuous batching. Implemented strict PII masking and structured JSON output schema validation.

case_studies.title: Real-time Defect Detection Pipeline with YOLO & TensorRT
case_studies.deliverables: Edge vision inspection system running on Jetson Orin with sub-15ms inference per frame.
case_studies.metrics: 99.8% precision, eliminated $450k/year in undetected assembly defects.
case_studies.full_text: Custom YOLOv8 architecture optimized via TensorRT FP16 quantization. Deployed across 12 assembly lines with automated alerting.

past_proposals.job_title: Build a multi-agent LangGraph workflow for customer support triage
past_proposals.proposal_text: Hi! In a recent FinTech engagement (cs_aiml_01), I built a LangGraph state graph with parallel agents and human-in-the-loop approval, processing 2.4M queries/month. For your triage needs, I will design a structured state graph with explicit handoffs and guardrails. Let's discuss your ticketing API.
past_proposals.client_feedback: Sarah's exact experience with LangGraph made this project a huge success.

past_proposals.job_title: RAG pipeline optimization for legal contracts
past_proposals.proposal_text: Hello. Naive RAG fails on legal clauses due to phrasing variations. Using hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval and claim verification (as shown in my hybrid-rag-engine project), we can guarantee zero hallucinations with citation footnotes.
I can build any AI bot quickly and guarantee #1 rank in efficiency.
